verdict.rationale: Gaming performance is a fair question for a laptop SoC, but the pack has no game benchmarks, frame-rate data, integrated GPU class or cache figures; the only related item is a vendor CPU boost clock of up to 5.0 GHz, which does not show real-game performance. Community comments note the lack of benchmarks and urge waiting for independent reviews, but they contain no concrete counter-evidence, so this is absence of evidence rather than a dispute.
